protection_domains.cybersecurity: credentials, dependencies, model/data provenance, unauthorized actuator commands
protection_domains.water_environment: rain, humidity, mud, dust, corrosion, washdown exposure; enclosure rating not established
protection_domains.fire_heat_power: battery management, overcurrent, motor/controller temperature, short circuit
protection_domains.communications: sensor disconnection, stale timestamps, network loss, GPS/position uncertainty
protection_domains.ai_data: four-stage coconut maturity classification, uncertain/out-of-distribution images, annotation provenance, false detections
protection_domains.mechanical: falling coconuts, arm/cutter limits, jam detection, load limits, unintended movement
protection_domains.human_mission: worker/animal exclusion zones, guarded cutting, emergency stop, safe stop and recovery

project_specific_hazards: working at palm height within the project's 0-30 m concept scope
